intro.title: Hello, I'm Xun Keran
intro.desc:
Automatic control and robotics enthusiast, currently snowed under.
Getting started with motion control, reinforcement learning, and robot perception.

item0.title: Long-Range Lob-Shot Hero Robot
item0.desc: As the electrical and control lead, took part in validation and development of the lob-shot hero robot: built a six-wheel friction lob mechanism with an OpenMV aiming-assist system to hit targets 20 m away, carried the project all the way to the Spring Cocoon arena, placed third in the revival-round lob deployment accuracy event and won a national third prize.

item1.title: Series-Legged Hero Robot
item1.desc: Electrical and control lead; contributed to the development of the wheel-legged hero robot and competed in RM2026, winning a national third prize.

item2.title: Omnidirectional Suspended-Chassis Infantry Robot
item2.desc: A combat robot built around dual DJI C boards as its main controllers. DJI3508 motors drive the omnidirectional chassis, while the controller IMU and DAMIAO motors keep the gimbal self-stabilised.

item3.title: Quadruped Bionic Slope-Climbing Robot
item3.desc: A servo control system designed in-house for the quadruped slope-climbing track of the 2025 China Engineering Robot Competition. Built around an STM32 board with eight high-precision grayscale sensors for environment sensing, the robot navigates autonomously and won national runner-up.

event1.title: Where it all began · 2025 RoboMaster University Series, Eastern Regional
event1.desc: Electrical and control lead for the omnidirectional wheeled robot; competed in the RoboMaster University Series regional event and won a national second prize.

event2.title: China Engineering Robot Competition & International Open
event2.desc: Electrical and control lead; built a quadruped with grayscale-line recognition and autonomous navigation, winning national runner-up.

event3.title: 2026 RoboMaster University Series, Northern Regional
event3.desc: Electrical and control lead; took part in developing the wheel-legged hero robot, winning a national third prize.

event4.title: Dream of the Spring Cocoon arena · 2026 RoboMaster University Series, National Revival Round
event4.desc: Electrical and control lead; participated in validation and development of the lob-shot hero robot, placing third in the revival-round lob deployment accuracy event and winning a national third prize.
